description_for_human: Trigger and observe SOP-constrained outbound safety call-outs.
description_for_model: Places SOP-constrained outbound phone calls to on-call contacts about equipment alarms (e.g. high-temperature), and reports service latency and health. Use triggerCallOut to start a call for a specific alarm; only call it when the user clearly asks to place or trigger a call and has supplied the required alarm details (store, equipment, current and threshold temperature, alarm time, customer). Never invent alarm data.

functions.name: triggerCallOut
functions.description: Place an outbound SOP call-out for an alarm. Requires alarm details; phone number is optional and auto-resolved when omitted.

functions.name: getLatencyMetrics
functions.description: Return current voice-to-voice latency statistics in milliseconds.

functions.name: getHealth
functions.description: Return orchestrator health and the active SOP id.
